For #CésarChávez, the farmworkers’ rights movement was about human dignity and respect.

His commitment to fighting for fair wages and fair treatment helped put the American Dream within reach for hardworking Latino families in California and across the country. https://t.co/xBhnlS5Jxp

Thrilled to have secured $1M in federal funding for @BCHD's new youth wellness center. 

The center will provide mental and physical health resources, education counseling, substance-use prevention programs and more for young people in #CA33. https://t.co/YaJeqOLARx

The world can be a challenging place, but you are not alone. Nearly 4 in 10 American adults report symptoms of anxiety or depression following the COVID-19 pandemic. Find support for you and your loved ones at https://t.co/SvIZlgffUd or text NAMI to 741741. #MentalHealthMonth https://t.co/13dMfazx6b

Did you know? The @USDA #SNAP program provides nutrition benefits to supplement the food budget of families in need and help them purchase healthy food. See if you're eligible today: https://t.co/jzdb9wHSot

Wild horses are beloved creatures who need our protection against inhumane treatment & the appalling horse slaughter pipeline. 

Pleased to lead a bipartisan letter to @USDA & @forestservice regarding management practices of wild horses at Devil’s Garden. https://t.co/LIToJwy5I4

Wishing @POTUS a speedy recovery. Glad he’s experiencing only mild symptoms, and that he’s fully vaccinated and boosted. 

For those in @CountyofLA seeking information on vaccines and other COVID resources, please visit https://t.co/B2Ojl7Jxfm.

This #RecoveryMonth, let's open dialogues about mental health with our loved ones. It's important for those who are struggling to know they are not alone. 

Find help today: https://t.co/Yl2Z5SiALt

📞 For confidential crisis counseling, dial 988. #CongressGoesPurple https://t.co/eWJCavxxgo
Proud to be named a @HSLegFund Legislative Leader! Will always fight to protect our beloved animals against cruel and inhumane treatment. #HumaneAwards https://t.co/SOdZmgWUIK

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth. The earlier breast cancer is detected, the higher the survival rate. Stay aware of the signs and symptoms to look out for and help spread the word. More info: https://t.co/yla3B9sYiY

Thrilled to attend the @BCHD public opening of the new allcove youth wellness center! Was honored to secure $1,000,000 for this amazing new program expanding access to mental health resources for young people in the South Bay. https://t.co/glTtYdFJdx

Cancer has touched each and every American. This #WorldCancerDay, we continue our work to make sure everyone, regardless of location, income, ethnicity, or gender, has access to cancer education, prevention, treatment and care. https://t.co/7XVlP2HP3d

Our economy needs a strong middle class. Unions are essential to rebuilding America's middle class and improving the lives of workers and their families. 

Today, @HouseDemocrats are introducing the #PROAct to empower workers to exercise their right to organize. https://t.co/JL5G4kOgjI

The MAGA @HouseGOP wants to cut critical programs, harming California veterans’ ability to get appointments for critical health care including mental health & substance disorder treatment. Our nation’s heroes deserve better than that.

More than 1 in 5 Americans experience mental illness each year, and less than half of them receive treatment. 

Pleased to stand with colleagues as we acknowledge #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth and recommit to eliminating stigma around mental illness. 

You are not alone. https://t.co/uNg9uLN95G

Proud to join @RepUnderwood, @RepAdams, and @SenBooker in introducing the #Momnibus which addresses our maternal health crisis by investing in:

‍⚕ maternal health workforce
❤️ community-based organizations
🏠 housing and nutrition
📝 maternal health research https://t.co/PH7lSa9YiT

On #WorldAIDSDay, we recommit to ending the HIV Epidemic and supporting those affected by HIV/AIDS. Let’s honor the memories of those we’ve lost by continuing to push for research, treatment, and support. https://t.co/536x85l8f8

Nutrition assistance for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) has made it easier for families to put food on the table for 25 years. But House Republicans’ failure to fund this program could leave 2 million women and children hungry. We must #FundWIC.

Remember just a few weeks ago when House Republicans said they support IVF?

Well 80% of them just endorsed a "budget" that backs the Life at Conception bill, which would effectively ban IVF treatment if enacted.

The hypocrisy is shameful. https://t.co/9Zcg6mYsPC

🏥 Calling all veterans! The PACT Act expands VA care and disability compensation for veterans from the Vietnam, Gulf War and post-9/11 eras, and increases coverage for toxic exposure. Your health matters. Check your eligibility today! https://t.co/rhNFORw5OE

AI technology is already revolutionizing health care and will only get more powerful. Great joining @RepScholten at Michigan State University to talk about the ways we’re working together to ensure American patients and medical professionals are helped, not harmed, by AI.

Thanks to Democrats’ Inflation Reduction Act, American families are saving hundreds each year on their health coverage and prescription drugs. We’re putting People Over Politics to lower costs and strengthen the middle class.
Cancer research and care should never be politicized or jeopardized. This World Cancer Day, we must recommit to ensuring access to life-saving treatment and preventative care.

TLDR: Federal funding helps provide crucial services to our community, including nutrition assistance, water infrastructure, and health research and treatment. We must continue to support their work and protect their funding.

Who relies on Medicaid in California?

– 61% of people living in nursing homes
– 48% of working-age adults with disabilities
– 43% of all children
– 40% of moms giving birth and their newborn babies

Republicans want to cut their coverage.

Republican cuts to Medicaid (Medi-Cal) will pull funding from service providers, reducing quality of care.

In CA, Medicaid provides: $14B to hospitals, $3B to mental health & nursing homes, 59% of community health center funding, and home/community care to 650,000 Californians.
